prompt: Create a standalone Android-first application named AI Mashup & Bootleg Studio. This is a NEW APP and MUST NOT be merged with or visually imitate the DJ Visual app. IMPORTANT BRANDING: the project already contains icon.svg. Use icon.svg as the primary visible brand mark in the app header/home screen and include <link rel="icon" href="icon.svg"> in the HTML head. Keep the logo crisp, centered where appropriate, premium, and not oversized. Do not replace it with emoji, generic music icons, or generated text art. Purpose: help a remixer build new mashup/bootleg arrangements from multiple user-supplied audio sources. Initial genre blueprints: Breakbeat, Tech House, Afro House, Club, Funkot, Dangdut, and Koplo. Mobile-first premium dark studio UI, centered controls, compact professional layout, not oversized. Core workflow: (1) New Project; (2) import 2-5 local audio files; (3) each source can be assigned as Vocal, Melody, Hook, Reference, or Full Track; (4) show source cards with filename, duration, manual BPM, manual key, start/end trim controls and audition play/stop; (5) provide song-part tagging such as Intro, Verse, Pre-Chorus, Chorus/Reff, Hook, Break, Drop; (6) genre Blueprint selector with visible arrangement timeline in 8/16/32-bar blocks; (7) allow drag-like/reorder or move-up/down arrangement sections; (8) controls for target BPM, target key, transpose semitones, vocal pitch, vocal formant character slider Male-Natural-Female, time stretch, vocal amount, melody amount, energy, FX amount; (9) mixer-style gain/mute/solo for each source; (10) Generate Arrangement button that builds a deterministic blueprint-based arrangement plan from the selected source tags and genre; (11) Preview section that uses browser Web Audio APIs for local playback/mixing where technically possible; (12) Export Project Plan to JSON and save/load projects locally; (13) show Render Audio as unavailable until a real audio-render backend is connected rather than pretending a file was rendered. Do not fake AI stem separation, voice conversion, mastering, or server rendering. Instead create a clear Processing Services panel with connection status for Stem Separation, BPM/Key Analysis, Voice Transform, Arrangement Intelligence, and Mastering, plus clean adapter functions/placeholders in code for later API integration. The app must still be genuinely usable offline as an arrangement planning and local audition prototype. Include default blueprint templates: Breakbeat = Intro 32, Groove 16, Vocal Tease 8, Build 16, Drop 32, Break/Reff 16, Drop 2 32, Outro 32; Tech House = Intro 32, Groove 32, Vocal Hook 16, Build 16, Drop 32, Break 16, Drop 2 32, Outro 32; Afro House = Intro 32, Groove 32, Vocal 16, Build 16, Drop 32, Break 16, Final Groove 32, Outro 32; Club = Intro 32, Groove 16, Vocal 16, Build 16, Drop 32, Break 16, Drop 2 32, Outro 32; Funkot = Intro 16, Groove 16, Vocal Hook 16, Build 8, Drop 32, Break 16, Drop 2 32, Outro 16; Dangdut = Intro 16, Verse 16, Reff 16, Instrumental 16, Reff 16, Break 8, Final Reff 16, Outro 16; Koplo = Intro 16, Verse 16, Reff 16, Kendang Build 8, Drop/Reff 32, Break 16, Final Drop 32, Outro 16. Include Custom Blueprint creation and save. Prioritize stability and clear state management. Store project data offline using localStorage or IndexedDB. Include no external copyrighted music, samples, artist names, copyrighted melodies, or bundled audio assets. The application must process only files the user imports. Add a concise rights notice in Settings that users are responsible for permissions when distributing transformed copyrighted material. Produce a polished index.html compatible with the existing ACC Builder Capacitor pipeline and a project.json as expected by the builder.
